subtitle: MLB player data analysis · AI scouting reports
ai_no_verified_season: A scouting report cannot be generated without verified season statistics. Check the season or statistical category.
advanced_note: MLB regular season · Locally calculated · Missing values: N/A · In-season data is provisional. Counting statistics depend on playing time; no single metric determines the better player.
metric_BABIP: Hit rate on balls in play excluding home runs. Higher is not always better.
metric_BB%: Walks per plate appearance for hitters or batters faced for pitchers.
metric_K%: Strikeouts per plate appearance for hitters or batters faced for pitchers.
metric_K-BB%: Strikeout rate minus walk rate, in percentage points.
metric_FIP: Uses HR, walks, hit batters, strikeouts and a seasonal constant. A difference from ERA does not prove a cause.
metric_wOBA: Weighted offensive outcomes using season-specific FanGraphs weights; locally calculated.
metric_OPS+: Park/league-adjusted OPS. N/A without verified source data.
metric_wRC+: Park/league-adjusted run production. N/A without verified source data.
metric_ERA+: Park/league-adjusted ERA. N/A without verified source data.
metric_K/9: Strikeouts per nine innings, calculated from outs.
metric_BB/9: Walks per nine innings, calculated from outs.
metric_HR/9: Home runs allowed per nine innings, calculated from outs.
sc_diagram_x: Source Horizontal Coordinates (relative to home; not distance)
sc_diagram_y: Source Vertical Coordinates (toward outfield; not distance)
sc_plate_x: plate_x (ft, catcher view; right is positive)
sc_coverage: Supported from 2015 through the current season. Historical tracking coverage varies by metric.
sc_load_note: Press the button to retrieve only this player’s regular-season events in chunks of up to 31 days. Full-season requests may take time.
sc_dates_error: Dates must lie within the selected season, with start no later than end.
sc_schema_error: Statcast response fields could not be verified. Standard statistics remain available.
sc_identity_error: Could not verify the player MLBAM ID or season.
sc_duplicate_conflict: Conflicting values share a pitch identifier; aggregation was stopped.
sc_access_error: The source restricted access or request rate. Retrieval stopped; please retry later.
sc_size_error: The response exceeded safe size limits. Retry with a shorter date range.
sc_network_error: Statcast connection or response failed. Shorten the range or retry later.
sc_bbe_count: {pitches} pitches · {bbe} batted-ball events · Valid sample shown separately per metric
sc_pitches_count: {n} retrieved pitches · Missing measurements excluded from each metric’s denominator
sc_no_locations: No usable hit coordinates. Locations are not inferred from launch angle or velocity.
sc_spray_note: Source-coordinate schematic: hc_x−125, 199−hc_y, with home at the origin. This does not establish stadium dimensions, distances, or exact landing points.
sc_normalized: Normalize by Each Batter’s Strike Zone
sc_location_note: Catcher view; positive x is right. Normalization uses each pitch’s sz_bot/sz_top. Feet mode overlays the observed batter-specific zones.
sc_location_2026: 2026+: plate_x/plate_z refer to the middle of the plate; zone heights follow ABS definitions.
sc_location_2025: Through 2025: plate_x/plate_z refer to the front of the plate.
sc_density_note: Fewer than 50 valid locations are shown as individual pitches, not density estimates.
sc_movement_note: Source pfx_x/pfx_z converted from feet to inches. Catcher-perspective pfx movement; not total drop or movement versus league average. Incompatible api_break definitions are not mixed.
sc_ai_enable: Enable local AI and select a model in the sidebar to analyze the Statcast summary.
sc_ai_prompt: Use only the supplied Statcast summary to explain contact quality, velocity, launch angle, hard-hit/barrel rates, or arsenal, speed, spin and movement. Compare monthly or seasonal values only when supplied. Distinguish source-published full-season metrics from selected-period summaries. Explain samples, denominators, missing data and tracking limitations. Separate evidence from interpretation; do not claim causation or overall superiority.
sc_limitations: Regular season · 2015+ · Full-season published values and selected-period summaries are distinct. CSV velocity/angle measurements can include source estimates; tracking systems and coverage vary over time.
sc_full_season: Source-Published · Full Selected Season (date filters do not apply)
sc_published_missing: Some published season data could not be verified. Those metrics are N/A.
sc_partial_error: Pitch-event retrieval did not complete. An incomplete period is not presented as a full-season aggregate.
sc_empty: No regular-season Statcast observations in this period. Records may be absent or outside tracking coverage.
sc_difference: Difference (first − second; percentage metrics in pp)
sc_period_warning: Check samples, date ranges and pitch mix together. No single metric determines superiority. In-season records are provisional.
sc_sources: Statcast Sources · Scope · Retrieval Time · Quality
sc_period_mismatch: Match the start and end dates for both players’ observed data.
sc_arsenal_compare_note: Select from the union of arsenals. Unthrown pitch types have N/A speed/spin; overall averages depend on pitch mix.
sc_help_avg_ev: Mean of available batted-ball exit velocities.
sc_help_hard_hit: Share of batted balls at least 95 mph; observed denominator is BBE with available exit velocity.
sc_help_barrel: Uses source barrel classification; observed denominator is BBE classified 1–6 in launch_speed_angle. May differ from the published season rate.
sc_help_sweet_spot: Share with launch angle between 8 and 32 degrees; observed denominator is BBE with available launch angle.
sc_help_xba: Source-published season expected batting average; no local model.
sc_help_xwoba: Source-published season expected weighted on-base average.
sc_help_xera: Source-published season expected ERA. Displayed PA is the leaderboard sample, not an ERA denominator.
sc_help_horizontal: Mean pfx_x converted from feet to inches; positive is right from catcher view.
sc_help_vertical: Mean pfx_z converted from feet to inches; distinct from total drop and movement versus average.
sc_help_whiff: Misses per recognized swing. Inspect description sets for bunt/pitchout handling. Not assumed identical to published leaderboard rates.
sc_help_usage: Pitch-type count divided by all retrieved pitches, including unknown types.
rank_intro: Separate hitter and pitcher populations for the selected regular season. Official percentiles and local calculations are distinct; no future predictions.
rank_source_partial: Some sources are unavailable. Only verified values are shown; official data is not automatically replaced by local calculations.
rank_identity_error: Could not verify matching player IDs, seasons and statistical categories.
rank_schema_error: Could not verify percentile format or the 0–100 range.
rank_population_n: Valid reference population for this metric: n={n}
rank_not_qualified: N/A: unqualified, unpublished, missing, or insufficient sample. Rules may vary by metric.
rank_official_note: Official CSV values are displayed without inversion. General criteria: 2.1 PA per team game for batters, 1.25 batters faced per team game for pitchers. Supplementary metrics may have different rules. n counts players with that percentile published in the CSV; no unpublished internal population is inferred.
rank_local_note: App criteria: hitters ≥300 PA, pitchers ≥200 batters faced. Missing values excluded per metric. Percentile=100×(average rank−1)/(n−1); ties averaged; lower-is-preferable metrics inverted. n<2 is N/A. These are not official Savant percentiles. Local spin rankings are unavailable because no simple favorable direction is assumed.
rank_direction_higher: Higher raw values are generally preferable; one metric does not determine overall quality.
rank_direction_lower: Lower raw values are generally preferable. Published percentiles already reflect the source’s orientation.
rank_direction_context: Interpret in context. Higher spin percentile alone does not establish pitch quality.
rank_similarity_note: Distance standardized within the same season/category. Similarity score=1/(1+standardized RMS distance); closer to 1 means more similar. Not probability, performance ranking or prediction.
rank_similarity_population: Population: {n} players including target · Excluded: {excluded} · Minimum PA/BF: {minimum} · Three equally weighted features
rank_similarity_unavailable: Similarity unavailable: insufficient playing time, missing features, too few eligible players, or zero feature variance. Missing values are not replaced with zero.
rank_feature_reason_hitting: Features: mean EV (contact quality), BB% (walk tendency), K% (strikeout tendency). Correlated xwOBA, Hard-Hit% and Barrel% are not added as extra weights.
rank_feature_reason_pitching: Features: mean EV allowed (contact quality), BB% allowed (control), K% (strikeouts). Whiff% and K-BB% are not double-weighted. This model does not measure arsenal or role similarity.
rank_pitcher_note: For pitchers, EV, Hard-Hit%, Barrel%, xBA and xwOBA are allowed batting results. BB% is walks allowed; K% is strikeouts.
rank_reason: Smallest standardized difference: {close} · Largest difference: {different}. This explanation covers only the model’s three features.
rank_standardized: Standardized Metrics in the Same Reference Population
rank_multiple_teams: Multiple Teams (affiliation list may be partial)
rank_sources: Sources · Qualification · Methods · Transformations · Retrieval Times
rank_ai_prompt: Use only the supplied Python percentile and similarity results to explain nearest players, matching traits and differences. Distinguish published from local percentiles, actual from standardized values. Never invent rankings, scores or missing values. Similarity is not probability, overall quality or prediction. Explain population, features, equal weights, qualification and sample limitations; separate evidence from interpretation.
career_fetch_error: Career retrieval or validation failed. This does not mean no records exist; existing features remain available.
career_schema_error: Could not verify the career response structure.
career_identity_error: Career player identity or season mismatch.

career_empty: No MLB regular-season career records returned for this category.
career_full_scope: Summary covers the complete selected-category career. Range filters below apply to charts, changes and peak candidates. Rates use official career values or pooled counts, never a simple average of seasonal rates.
career_source: MLB Stats API · Regular season · Retrieved {at}
career_rules: App sample criteria: hitting rates ≥300 PA; pitching rates ≥100 IP (K-BB% also requires ≥300 BF). These are not official title qualification rules. Incomplete seasons are excluded from peak/change candidates.
career_unverified: Some seasons or calendar metadata could not be verified. See provenance for status.
career_shortened_note: 1994, 1995 and 2020 are marked as known shortened seasons. Other historical formats may differ; interpret counting statistics alongside playing time.
career_missing: Years without returned regular-season records (excluding errors)
career_load_league: Load MLB League Averages by Season
career_load_context: Load Supplementary Data for Selected Range
career_context_missing: Some league/Statcast data is unavailable. Missing values remain N/A.
career_smooth_note: Smoothed rates are recomputed from pooled counts over three consecutive calendar seasons. Gaps are not skipped and lines are not extrapolated. Unsupported metrics remain unavailable.
career_direction_context: Interpret with Playing Time and Context
career_yoy_note: Compares successive verified played seasons. Gaps greater than one are not consecutive calendar seasons. Percentage metrics use percentage-point differences. Relative change is omitted for nonpositive baselines and percentage/index/innings metrics.
career_findings_note: Descriptive rule: OPS change ≥0.100 or ERA change ≥1.00 between sample-qualified completed seasons. This is not a significance test or an inference about talent or causes.
career_insufficient: Insufficient samples, metrics or completed seasons, or no result meets the rule.
career_breakout_note: Completed-season candidate: league-relative ratio exceeds the preceding 2–3 qualified-season baseline by ≥0.15 and is ≥1. Uses OPS/lgOPS for hitters and lgERA/ERA for pitchers, not OPS+ or ERA+. Load each season’s MLB averages first.
career_no_breakout: Verified league context, prior seasons or samples are insufficient, or no season meets the breakout rule.
career_peak: Peak Recorded Season for Selected Criterion
career_peak_note: Only completed, sample-qualified seasons are compared; all ties are shown. A peak by one metric is not an objectively best overall season.
career_stages_note: App-defined descriptive stages by played-season order: 1–3, 4–6, 7–10, 11+. Not official MLB classifications or judgments about physical development/aging. Rates use pooled counts.
career_awards_error: Awards retrieval failed; this does not establish absence of awards.
career_ai_prompt: Use only supplied Python career summaries and deltas to report: 1.Overview 2.Statistical improvements 3.Declines/fluctuations 4.Peaks by selected criterion 5.League-relative performance 6.Verified awards 7.Data limitations 8.Overall interpretation. Do not infer injuries, mechanics, aging, talent, causes or future outcomes. Rule-based candidates are not significance tests; explain missing data and calendar gaps.
career_provenance: Career Sources · Aggregation Methods · Season Status
career_comparison_note: Career year uses verified MLB debut, falling back to the first recorded season in this category. Calendar gaps count as elapsed years. Consider PA/IP, role and era; similar players’ later records do not predict future performance.

lb_fetch_error: Complete population could not be verified. Partial responses are not ranked. If prior data is displayed, check its retrieval time and retry.
lb_source: Full population {n} · MLB Stats API · Retrieved {at} · Cache policy {policy}
lb_partial: Some affiliation/Statcast data is unavailable. Unavailable metrics are omitted; team/league rankings are blocked for incomplete affiliations.
lb_empty: No players meet the filters with a valid ranking metric. Check qualification, playing time and missing data.
lb_age_note: Age is calculated at July 1 of the selected season from birth date. Historical seasons never use current age. Missing birthdays are excluded only when an age filter is active.
lb_search: Search Player Names in Results (also narrows ranking population)

lb_eligible: After filters/valid metric: {n} players · Original MLB API qualified pool: {qualified}
lb_method: Ranks use the entire filtered population after excluding missing ranking values. Ties use 1,2,2,4; MLB ID breaks display order only. Qualification applies to counts too. Additional playing-time/team/age/stat filters create custom ranks, not official published rankings.
lb_table_sort_note: Sorting table headers changes display only. Use the ranking metric/direction controls to change ranks. Select one row for discovery or two for comparison.
lb_download: Download All Filtered Results as CSV

lb_subset_percentile: Local percentile within complete current filtered population: {value} · n={n} · Uses selected sort direction (not probability/overall quality)
lb_percentile_error: Could not verify source-published percentiles. Filtered-subset percentiles are not substituted.

Separate verified values from interpretation. Do not invent players, ranks, means, causes or predictions. Note the top-25 context limit and never confuse filtered ranks with official MLB-wide ranks.
lb_unavailable: OPS+, wRC+, ERA+ and WAR are omitted without verified consistent definitions. wOBA/FIP require previously verified seasonal constants.
lb_schema_error: Could not verify season response structure/category.
lb_population_error: Ranking stopped: population/page counts, duplicate players or seasons could not be reconciled.
lb_identity_error: Leaderboard player identity, season or category mismatch.
lb_memberships_error: Season affiliations are incomplete; team/league filtered ranks cannot be produced. Reload source data.
lb_statcast_error: Statcast season summaries are unavailable; basic statistics remain available.
lb_metric_error: Select a verified metric for this category.
lb_preset_save: Save Current Settings Under a New Name
lb_presets_error: Could not read/write presets. Existing files are not reset.
lb_preset_exists: Duplicate name or preset limit reached. Existing presets are not overwritten.
lb_deleted: Only the confirmed preset was deleted.
lb_stale: The loaded snapshot is older than its refresh window. Reload using the button above before treating it as current.
